title: Became supervisory manager of 9 software competency experts
summary: In April 2023 I moved from functional to supervisory manager of nine software competency experts, and helped run the wider Software Center of Excellence team across six nationalities and twelve locations.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a role event, not an intervention.
the_call: Take on direct people leadership and stay hands-on with the businesses.
what_i_did: Delegated the team's transformation work with the businesses and owned hiring recommendations and annual performance reviews.
what_changed: Nine direct reports, and a team scope that covered businesses in North America and Latin America.
